english.title: Drive vehicle more than 4.5 hours without minimum break of 45 minutes - EC
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), for more than four and a half hours, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERIOD OF DRIVING..), without observing a minimum break of forty five minutes in contravention of Article 7(1) of the Community Drivers' Hours Regulation
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(11A) of the Transport Act 1968.

english.notes:
(i) Temporary exception during the period from 22nd January 2021 and ending with 31st March 2021 whilst driver is in Kent and undertaking a relevant journey: see regulation 3(3) and (4) of the Drivers' Hours and Tachographs (Temporary Exceptions) Regulations 2021, where a driver may replace the uninterrupted break after a driving period of four and a half hours by a break of at least 15 minutes followed by one or two breaks totalling at least 30 minutes, each of at least 15 minutes, and each distributed over the period.
(ii) See Article 7(2) for replacement of 45 minute break by breaks of 15 minutes.
(iii) Where the place of offence is uncertain, section 103(7) provides that the offence may be treated as having been committed at the place of driving, the person's place of residence or the principal place of business.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H3180 and H3181.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant drove **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) for a total period of **(..SPECIFY PERIOD OF TIME DRIVING..), without observing a minimum break of forty five minutes in contravention of Article 7(1) of the Community Drivers' Hours Regulation.
